name: Stage Control
author: marcho78
description: Organize your desktops from one view. Swipe up with four fingers (or press Super+A) and every window steps onto the stage as a live preview, under a bar of all your desktops with live thumbnails. Drag windows onto any desktop; add, remove, reorder and rename desktops, and keep empty ones until you remove them. Close windows, or swipe down for just the current app's windows. Liquid Glass styling, hot corners, and a settings window for gestures, shortcuts and looks.

barWidget.description: Stage Control. Click for settings, right-click to open the stage, middle-click for the current app's windows.
